title: HM Level Design Tools
lede: Browser tools for designing, checking and reading levels of HM Games projects. Open a tool from its card; each one runs on its own, nothing to install.

tools.name: Valley Smash level editor
tools.summary: Edit shooter levels on a board with the game's real art in 2D and 3D views, load a level folder, save back in place.
tools.source: block-shot-2 exporter → art/ → inline_art.py (pipeline in the tool folder)

tools.name: Fish Sort blocker report
tools.summary: Where each blocker mechanic appears across levels 1 to N, as charts and a level table, from the level data.

tools.name: Valley Smash level dashboard
tools.summary: Per-level win rate, churn and ammo surplus from BigQuery exports, with walls flagged.
